title: The Kite That Chased the Wind

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='Tomas and Grandma Rosa sit at the kitchen table with paper scraps, string, and bamboo sticks; the spring festival kite contest is on Saturday; the wind sock on the porch flips north, then east, then flat; they must pick a kite shape that can handle a wind that keeps changing'>>

choices.label: Build a red diamond kite
Build a box kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They cross two bamboo sticks, tie the middle tight, and glue red tissue paper over the frame; the window rattles as the wind teases them; Grandma Rosa says a diamond kite is quick but jumpy, and Tomas wonders whether to test it right away or steady it with a tail first'>>

choices.label: Test it on Windy Hill
Braid a tail for it first

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They roll stiff paper into tubes and build a box kite with open ends; Grandma Rosa says box kites love strong wind; outside, the pine tops on the ridge sway one way and then the other, so the two of them will need to test it and check every string'>>

choices.label: Test it in the low meadow
Ask Grandma to check the knots

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='First test on Windy Hill; the kite leaps up, then a sudden gust snaps one bamboo stick with a crack; the red diamond flops down on the grass; Tomas holds the broken stick and thinks about how to make the kite fly again'>>

choices.label: Mend the stick with a garden cane
Rebuild the frame with new wood

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Back at the table they braid a tail from cloth scraps of an old apron; too short and the kite will spin, too heavy and it will sag; while they braid, the wind outside dies flat and then puffs hard again, and one bamboo stick bends worryingly when Tomas flexes it'>>

choices.label: Make the frame lighter too
Tie on a second ribbon tail

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='They test the box kite in the low meadow, but the air goes completely still and the kite sits down in the clover; Grandma Rosa points at the ridge, where the treetops still flutter, and says the wind is up there hiding; Tomas wants to learn its tricks'>>

choices.label: Learn to spot the moving air
Check every knot while waiting

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Grandma Rosa tugs the bridle strings and one knot slips loose; she teaches Tomas the fisherman knot she learned as a girl on the harbor docks; while they practice, the flag over the bakery snaps around to a brand new direction'>>

choices.label: Practice the knot until it holds
Cut vent flaps for big gusts

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='They splint the snapped stick with a thin garden cane and strong glue; the mended kite is a little heavier now, but the joint holds when Tomas presses it; outside, the evening wind swirls in slow circles around Windy Hill, hard to predict'>>

choices.label: Try a practice flight at dusk
Rest the kite until festival morning

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Grandma Rosa planes two cedar strips thin and smooth, and Tomas rebuilds the diamond frame lighter and straighter than before; wood shavings curl like little waves on the floor; the new kite feels eager in his hands, tugging even at the breeze from the open door'>>

choices.label: Test the new frame at dusk
Save it for the festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=60 beats='They tie on two ribbon tails instead of one, and the kite hangs perfectly balanced from the ceiling hook; outside the wind shifts again, blowing in from the sea now and smelling like rain; Tomas taps the tails and watches them swing'>>

choices.label: Fly it once before dark
Wait for festival morning

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Grandma Rosa shows Tomas how the ridge trees tell where the wind flows, still air down in the meadow but a moving river of air up high; Tomas practices calling out when a wind window opens and closes; three times he calls it right before the leaves even move'>>

choices.label: Practice in the lane tonight
Rest up for the festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='Tomas reties every bridle knot with the fisherman knot until each one holds; Grandma Rosa tugs each string as hard as she can and nothing slips; it takes twelve tries and his fingers are sore, but the box kite is tight as a drum'>>

choices.label: Try the kite in the lane
Sleep and fly tomorrow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='They cut small vent flaps in the box kite panels so big gusts can blow through instead of tearing the paper; careful scissor lines, tape at every corner; Grandma Rosa blows through a flap to test it and the paper puffs like a tiny sail'>>

choices.label: Test the vents tonight
Keep it safe until morning

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Festival morning; overnight the wind changed again and now blows brisk and steady off the sea; banners fill the square, churro carts steam, and the red diamond kite waits by the door; Grandma Rosa asks whether they should hurry to the hill or join the parade'>>

choices.label: Hurry to the hilltop early
March in with the parade

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=75 beats='A practice flight at dusk on Windy Hill; the diamond kite climbs well but keeps dipping to the left, again and again; Grandma Rosa squints at the bridle strings by lantern light and says one string may be a whisker too long; it is getting late and tomorrow is the festival'>>

choices.label: Fix the bridle by lantern light
Leave it and get some sleep

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Festival morning; the flags over the square snap hard in a big pushing wind; the box kite hums softly as Tomas carries it to the field; Grandma Rosa watches the flags and says a wind like this needs a plan for the line'>>

choices.label: Fly on a short, reefed line
Let out the whole spool

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=75 beats='Evening practice in the lane behind the bakery; the box kite hums in the wind like a happy bee; the neighbor girl Mia is there with her striped kite and offers to lend her smooth wooden reel, much nicer than the old sticking spool Tomas has been using'>>

choices.label: Borrow the smooth reel from Mia
Stick with the old wooden spool

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='They reach Windy Hill first, with dew still on the grass; the sea wind blows long and even at last; the red diamond kite tugs at the line like a puppy ready to run; far below, the judges set up their table and the contest bell waits'>>

choices.label: Let out the line for a high climb
Fly low and rock-steady

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='They arrive with the parade and kites already crowd the sky like confetti; lines cross and dip everywhere over the festival field; a judge rings the first bell; there is one small gap in the crowd of kites, or they could wait for the quieter round at sunset'>>

choices.label: Squeeze into a gap and launch
Wait for the quiet sunset round

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='By lantern light they shorten the left bridle string by two finger widths; at dawn the kite flies straight as an arrow over the garden fence, no dip at all; Tomas whoops; at the festival field the judges are calling for the high-flying contest and the fun-flying field is open too'>>

choices.label: Enter the high-flying contest
Fly it with Grandma just for joy

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='At the festival the kite still dips left every time the wind pushes; the gusts come in big shoves off the sea; Grandma Rosa holds out her weathered hand and offers to hold the line with him, or Tomas can wrestle the dipping kite through the gusts alone'>>

choices.label: Fly it alone through the gusts
Share the line with Grandma

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='On the short reefed line the box kite sits steady as a table even in the hard wind; little kids gather under it, mouths open; the judge with the blue sash strolls over to watch; Tomas can enter the steady-flying contest or show the little kids how the kite drinks the wind'>>

choices.label: Enter the steady-flying contest
Show the little kids how it works

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The box kite hauls line off the spool, up and up, until the string hums like a guitar and the spool jumps in Tomas hands; Grandma Rosa calls a warning over the wind that the line is near its end and the gusts are getting meaner'>>

choices.label: Let it climb to the very last turn
Ask Grandma to hold the reel too

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='With the smooth borrowed reel the box kite flies calm and true beside Mia and her striped kite; the two kites ride the same river of air over the festival field; Mia wants to try a looping trick together, but the flags along the square are starting to snap in a new direction'>>

choices.label: Try a looping trick together
Watch the flags and pick the calm lane

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The old wooden spool sticks and jerks as the line runs out; the morning contest wind is fast and mean, but Grandma Rosa says the sunset round will be calmer and kinder to a sticky spool; the first bell rings across the field'>>

choices.label: Enter the wild morning round
Wait and fly in the sunset calm

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='The red diamond kite climbs higher than every other kite at the festival, a red speck against the blue; the judge pins a blue ribbon to Tomas jacket while Grandma Rosa cheers loudest of all; Tomas remembers every snapped stick and every fix, and grins because the changing wind finally blew their way'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=75 beats='Their kite is not the highest in the sky, but it is the steadiest, holding its place while other kites wobble and dive; the crowd claps and the judge with the blue sash says steady beats lucky every time; Grandma Rosa squeezes Tomas shoulder as they win the steady-flier prize'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='Tomas shows the little kids how the box kite drinks the wind and how treetops and flags tell you where the wind will jump next; he realizes he can read the changing wind now, the very thing that ruined every test all week; Grandma Rosa laughs and says the festival just found its youngest wind teacher'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='Four hands on one line; Tomas and Grandma Rosa steer through every gust together, leaning and laughing as the kite swoops and settles; they do not win a single ribbon and do not care; the kite they built and fixed together dances over the festival all afternoon long'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='They miss the big morning contest, and Tomas feels a small pang about that; but at sunset the tricky wind finally settles smooth and warm; their kite floats in the orange sky over the quiet square, the last kite flying; not a prize day, Grandma Rosa says, but a very good flying day'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=75 beats='Two kite lines cross, wrap, and both kites spiral gently down to the grass; Tomas and Mia sit untangling string for ages and end up laughing about it; they trade kite-fixing tricks, plan to fly again tomorrow, and share churros with Grandma Rosa while the festival band plays'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='A hard gust rips the sail from corner to corner and the kite sinks slowly to the grass; Tomas blinks back tears as the crowd sighs; Grandma Rosa folds the torn kite as gently as a blanket and promises that next spring they will build an even stronger one, together'>>
